ArtifactProgram.description: `ProgramSpec` plus `interface`, as written inside an artifact.

input_declarations.description:
As `ProgramSpec`'s field of the same name, last of its fields so the
two serialize in the same order.

interface.description: The program's entity roster, input slots and relations, derived from the program; the loader re-derives it and refuses an artifact whose block differs. Execution never reads it.

module.description:
Module-level metadata (source pinning, encoding provenance,
validation status) carried through RuleSpec lowering for tooling and
artifact pass-through. Load/compile boundaries validate it; execution
semantics do not depend on it.

selected_year_inputs.description:
As `ProgramSpec`'s field of the same name, first so the two serialize
in the same order.

fast_path.description:
Advisory: the compiling engine's static scan for constructs bulk fast
mode declines or cannot answer, one blocker per occurrence. Execution
never reads it. Fast mode decides per request and reports
any fallback in the response's `metadata.fallback_reason`. A later
engine whose fast mode has since gained a listed construct still loads
the artifact and keeps this value unchanged, with a
`stale_fast_path_metadata` diagnostic.

input_catalog.description:
Required in format 3. Defaulted only so a format-2 artifact that
predates the catalog can be read at all: the format-2 compatibility
loader fills an absent one from the embedded program. A catalog that
IS present is still checked against the program, so an explicit `[]`
remains a mismatch rather than a way to skip the check.

oneOf.description: Inferred from the read sites.
Reserved for the day RuleSpec declares input types.

DTypeSpec.description: Output data type. Canonical: judgment, bool, integer, decimal, text, date. Aliases (accepted, but not emitted): PascalCase forms and Money/money/Rate/rate for decimal.

corpus_citation_path.description:
Corpus provision path of the rule's origin module
(`module.source_verification.corpus_citation_path`), carried per rule
so artifact consumers can join the rule to its legal source.

rounding.description:
Opt-in output-rounding mode. When present AND `unit` is a declared
currency, the rule's output is rounded to the unit's `minor_units` under
this mode in every execution path. Absent means today's behavior (no
rounding). Declaring it on a non-currency unit is a compile error.

EncodingProvenance.description:
Who and what produced the encoding: tool (`encoder`, for example
`axiom-encode/0.2.645`), `model`, `run_id`, and human `reviewed_by`.
All fields optional; unknown subfields are rejected so typos do not
silently pass for provenance.

EngineBuild.description:
Which build of the engine compiled an artifact, stamped by `build.rs`.
Two builds with the same `engine_version` can differ here, and builds that
differ here write artifacts that differ in this field alone.

commit.description:
The commit the engine was built from (40 lowercase hex digits), or
null when the build could not know it.

dirty.description:
Whether the engine's `src/`, `build.rs`, `Cargo.toml` or `Cargo.lock`
differed from that commit; null when unknown, and always null when
`commit` is.

EntityInstances.description: Where a kind's instances come from.

oneOf.description: The caller supplies the instances.

A filtered entity whose ids are the ids of kind `of` (null when the
program does not establish it); `via` names the derived relations
that filter to it.
The entity-free scope, `Scalar`.

blockers.description:
One `<rule>: <reason>` entry per occurrence of a construct bulk fast
mode declines or cannot answer, in rule order, each rule's formula
before its versions. It is a static scan: a construct only a dead
branch reaches never forces a fallback at runtime; nothing inside a
relation aggregation is listed, because fast mode evaluates those on
the explain interpreter; and date-valued literals, inputs and parameter
values, which bulk fast mode also declines, are not listed.

corpus_citation_path.description:
Corpus provision path of the rule's origin module
(`module.source_verification.corpus_citation_path`), carried per rule
so artifact consumers can join the parameter to its legal source.

InputDType.description: The narrowest type every read site of a slot demands.

oneOf.description: A whole number: a tagged integer, or a decimal with zero fraction.
A number: a tagged integer or a decimal.

InputDeclarationSpec.description: A module's declaration about one input it reads.

input.description:
The declaring module's request name for the input:
`<module>#input.<slot>`, or the bare slot for an originless
composition root.

InputElection.description:
A choice the law gives a named actor: the input records which way the
actor chose. The engine evaluates the value it is given and never
defaults one; choosing among values belongs to the simulation layer. An
input without an election is a fact.

actor.description:
The entity kind that makes the choice, an UpperCamelCase label. The
program need not evaluate on it.

provision.description: The corpus citation path of the provision that gives the choice.

id_template.description:
`<kind>:{index}`, counting from 1, for a supplied kind; the template of
the aliased kind for an alias; null for `Scalar` and for an alias whose
kind the program does not establish.

default.description: The literal every read site defaults to, when they all agree.

election.description:
Who chooses the value and under which provision, when a module
declares the input an election; null for a fact, which a simulator
must not optimize over.

entities.description:
Every entity kind whose ids a read site of the slot can be evaluated
on.

values.description: A closed domain of whole numbers.

accepts_supplied_tuples.description:
Whether the evaluator reads tuples supplied under the relation's own
name.

lookup_slots.description:
The slots aggregates and membership tests key on, with a derived
relation's traversal of its source counted against the source.

slot_entities.description:
The effective slot kinds, in tuple order; null for a relation that
declares none.

oneOf.description:
Holds when exactly one item holds. First-class in the serialized
surface so artifacts and graph consumers see one n-input gate;
`to_model` lowers it to the flat Or-of-And-of-Nots expansion the
formula sugar produced before this variant existed, so evaluation,
short-circuit reads, missing-input faults, and trace text are
unchanged. Outcomes and faults also match hand-written expansions
on every input; trace TEXT does not match those byte-for-byte,
because hand-chained and/or nest as binary pairs while this
lowering is flat n-ary. Expression-level, additive to the
serialized surface — no artifact-format-version bump.

`t.name` for a judgment derived rule in a derived relation's
predicate: the rule evaluated at the term's id.

ModuleMetadata.description:
Module-level metadata block of a RuleSpec document. Every field is
optional; the whole block is descriptive and inert — it never affects
lowering output names, compilation, or execution. The lowered
[`ProgramSpec`] keeps the (merged) root module's metadata so tooling
reading a loaded module or a compiled artifact can see it.

interpretations.description: Descriptive readings adopted where source text is ambiguous, conflicting, or read other than literally. Never affects execution. Interpretation IDs must be unique within the module, alternative IDs must be unique within each interpretation, and affects must name rules defined in the same document. These identity and reference constraints require engine load-time validation. Corpus excerpt verification is the encoder's responsibility.

ProgramInterface.description:
`program.interface`. Every list is sorted except a relation's
`slot_entities`, which keeps tuple order.

entities.description: One entry per entity kind the program can evaluate on, by kind.

inputs.description: One entry per input slot some expression reads, by name.

relations.description: One entry per declared relation, by name.

RelationProvenance.description: What the declaration makes a relation.

oneOf.description: A data relation.
A `derived_relation`.

rule.description: The id of the rule that derives it.

RelationReads.description: What a derived relation's predicate mentions directly.

rules.description: Rule ids (the public id, or the name of a rule without one).

oneOf.description:
`min`/`max` (and `min_where`/`max_where`) over related entities. A
new variant: an engine without it refuses the artifact on load, and a
program that does not use it serializes exactly as before.

`only(relation.field)`: the value of the single related entity. Zero
or several members fail the evaluation.

The fallback of a `match` without a `_ =>` arm, reached only when the
subject equals none of `patterns`; evaluating it is an error, never a
value. It carries the subject and every listed pattern so evaluators
that compute both branches of a conditional can tell which rows reach
it.

Reduction over an entity's own period axis (lifetime execution only).
`n` is present only for the `sum_top_n` reduction. Expression-level,
additive to the serialized surface — no artifact-format-version bump.

`t.name` for an input in a derived relation's predicate: the input
read at the term's id. An engine without relation roles refuses the
unknown `kind` on load.

`t.name` for a scalar derived rule in a derived relation's predicate:
the rule evaluated at the term's id.

value.description: Decimal value as a quoted string (arbitrary precision) or a JSON integer; floats are rejected.

SourceClosure.description:
Which RuleSpec text an artifact was compiled from: every module text the
loader read to lower the program, the root included. It identifies module
text and nothing else; a corpus provision index, which fills `source_url`
fields after compilation, is not in it.

digest.description:
`sha256:` and the SHA-256 of `axiom-rules-engine/source-closure/v1\n`
followed by one `<target>\t<sha256>\n` line per module, in order
(an empty target for an originless root).

modules.description: One entry per module text, sorted by target, an originless root first.

root.description:
The root module's canonical target; null for an originless root (an
in-memory string, or a composition file).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the module's exact text, 64 lowercase hex digits.

target.description: The module's canonical target; null for an originless root.

SourceVerification.description:
Grounding of a module in legal source text. `corpus_citation_path`
addresses the provision in the Axiom corpus; `source_sha256` pins the
SHA-256 hex digest of the exact provision text the module was encoded
from, so tooling can detect mechanically when the published source has
changed out from under the encoding. `upstream_source_check` records the
higher-authority sources checked before using guidance or another
implementation source. The mapping is exact: the singular citation path
is required and unknown/plural fields are rejected.

TermSpec.description:
An end of the pair a derived relation's predicate tests, mirroring
[`crate::model::Term`].

oneOf.description: The id the relation is read from: its current slot.
The id being tested: its related slot.

UpstreamSourceCheck.description:
Structural record of a higher-authority source audit. The encoder owns
semantic policy for accepted statuses, path authority, and rationale
quality; the engine preserves the exact typed record in compiled artifacts.

ValidationRecord.description:
One oracle-validation result for the module: which oracle, whether the
encoding currently matches it, and when it last ran.

ValidationStatus.description:
Outcome of an oracle validation run. Any other status string is
rejected at parse time.

oneOf.description: The table keys of the parameters every read site indexes.

description: A compiled RuleSpec program, artifact format 3: the ProgramSpec IR with its interface block (entity roster, input slots and relations), evaluation order, fast-path metadata and input catalog, stamped with the artifact format version, the compiling engine's version and build, and the digests of the RuleSpec module texts it was compiled from. Produced by `axiom-rules-engine compile`.

engine_version.description: The semantic version of the engine that compiled the artifact.

source_closure.description: Omitted when the artifact was compiled from a ProgramSpec, which has no RuleSpec source.

title: Axiom compiled program artifact
